headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率涨超5.3个基点，投资者关注中东局势的影响
headlines.summary: 周四（7月23日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率涨4.27个基点，报4.6972%。 两年期美债收益率涨5.35个基点，报4.3512%，北京时间19:00-22:09加速上涨；30年期美债收益率涨2.21个基点，报5.1669%。 2/10年期美债收益率利差跌1.072个基点，报+34.387个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率涨5.52个基点，至2.4194%，01:00美国财政部披露标售/拍卖结果时重新扩大涨幅；两年期TIPS收益率涨3.46个基点，至2.3734%；30年期TIPS收益率涨3.05个基点，至2.9649%。
headlines.title_zh: 美国两年期国债收益率涨超5.3个基点，投资者关注中东局势的影响
headlines.summary_zh: 周四（7月23日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率涨4.27个基点，报4.6972%。 两年期美债收益率涨5.35个基点，报4.3512%，北京时间19:00-22:09加速上涨；30年期美债收益率涨2.21个基点，报5.1669%。 2/10年期美债收益率利差跌1.072个基点，报+34.387个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率涨5.52个基点，至2.4194%，01:00美国财政部披露标售/拍卖结果时重新扩大涨幅；两年期TIPS收益率涨3.46个基点，至2.3734%；30年期TIPS收益率涨3.05个基点，至2.9649%。
headlines.summary_en: Thursday (July 23) New York afternoon, US 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.27 bps to 4.6972%. 2-year Treasury yield rose 5.35 bps to 4.3512%, accelerating from 19:00-22:09 Beijing time; 30-year Treasury yield rose 2.21 bps to 5.1669%. 2/10-year Treasury yield spread narrowed 1.072 bps to +34.387 bps. 10-year TIPS yield rose 5.52 bps to 2.4194%, re-expanding gains after US Treasury auction results at 01:00; 2-year TIPS yield rose 3.46 bps to 2.3734%; 30-year TIPS yield rose 3.05 bps to 2.9649%.

headlines.title: Shanghai beats GDP estimates with 5.6% growth – but two-speed recovery persists
headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...
headlines.title_zh: 上海GDP增长5.6%超预期，但双速复苏态势延续
headlines.summary_zh:
上海市上半年经济同比增长5.6%，受高科技制造业和出口强劲增长推动，表现优于预期，但消费支出疲软凸显复苏不均衡。
根据市统计局周一发布的数据，该增速超过全国4.7%的增长水平

headlines.title: 中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作
headlines.summary: 【中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作】7月23日，中国人民银行发布2026年7月份中期借贷便利（MLF）招标公告。公告显示，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年7月24日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元MLF操作，期限为1年期。

headlines.summary_en: [PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan MLF operation today] On July 23, the PBOC issued the July 2026 Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) tender notice. The notice stated that to maintain ample banking system liquidity, the PBOC will conduct a 500 billion yuan MLF operation on July 24, 2026, with fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award, for a 1-year term.

headlines.title: 证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会 综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行 提升资本市场韧性
headlines.summary: 【证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会 综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行 提升资本市场韧性】7月23日，中国证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会，总结上半年证监会系统党的建设和监管工作，分析当前形势，推动完成全年目标任务。会议认为“市场整体具备较好的配置价值”，并部署了七方面工作，包括综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行、推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例、加强新型业务监管等。

headlines.summary_en: [CSRC holds party building and regulatory work symposium, comprehensive measures to maintain market stability and enhance market resilience] On July 23, the CSRC held a party building and regulatory work symposium, summarizing H1 2026 party building and regulatory work, analyzing current conditions, and driving completion of annual targets. The meeting noted 'the market overall has good allocation value' and outlined seven areas of work, including comprehensive measures to maintain market stability, promoting medium- and long-term funds to steadily increase market entry scale and proportion, and strengthening oversight of new business types.

headlines.title: 7月以来机构调研近540家上市公司，多只绩优标的成“心头好”
headlines.summary: 7月以来已有近540家上市公司接待机构调研，其中超110家公司预计上半年净利润同比增长，部分业绩高增标的获得机构密集关注。近期A股进入调整阶段，对于后市走势，业内人士认为，在政策支持以及科技产业趋势仍在发展的背景下，未来市场情绪或逐步修复。对于科技板块，需要在波浪式前进中把握投资节奏，消费板块开始逐步具备配置价值，此外进入“击球区”的黄金也值得关注。（中证报）

headlines.summary_en: Since July, nearly 540 listed companies have received institutional surveys, with over 110 expected to report year-on-year net profit growth in H1, with some high-growth stocks drawing intensive institutional attention. As A-shares enter an adjustment phase, industry insiders believe that with policy support and ongoing tech industry trends, market sentiment may gradually recover. For the tech sector, investment rhythm should be managed amid wave-like progress, the consumer sector is beginning to show allocation value, and gold entering the 'sweet spot' is also worth noting.

headlines.title: 今年上半年中国汽车出口超6000亿元，同比增长48.3%
headlines.summary: 今年上半年，我国汽车出口6358.2亿元，同比增长48.3%，销往全球210多个国家和地区。其中，新能源汽车出口3606.8亿元，同比增长68.7%。（央视新闻）

headlines.summary_en: In H1 2026, China's auto exports reached 635.82 billion yuan, up 48.3% year-on-year, shipped to over 210 countries and regions. Among them, new energy vehicle exports were 360.68 billion yuan, up 68.7% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 卡尼：针对美关税威胁，将“不惜一切代价”维护利益
headlines.summary: 据加拿大媒体报道，加拿大总理马克·卡尼23日表示，针对美国政府近期发出的关税威胁，加拿大政府将“不惜一切代价”维护本国利益。 卡尼当天在爱德华王子岛省夏洛特敦举行的全国地方领导人会议闭幕致辞中说，面对美方关税施压，加拿大政府将坚决保护和支持本国工人、农民、企业及家庭。

headlines.summary_en: According to Canadian media, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on the 23rd that in response to recent US tariff threats, the Canadian government will 'spare no expense' to protect national interests. Carney stated during closing remarks at the National Meeting of Local Leaders in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, that facing US tariff pressure, the Canadian government will firmly protect and support its workers, farmers, businesses, and families.
